    'Mai puri kayenat meiṅ Husain ka payaam bar': 'Main puri kaainaat mein Husain ka payaam bar',
}
assert not changes.keys() - set(lines)
fixed = []
for line in lines:

    for old, new in (

    fixed.append(line)
updated = metadata + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + '\\n'.join('  ' + line for line in fixed) + '\\n---\\n' + source
assert updated.split('\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == source
assert all(c.isascii() or c in 'ṅṄ' for c in '\\n'.join(fixed))
p.write_text(updated)

import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

assert all(line.startswith('  ') and all(c.isascii() or c in 'ṅṄ' for c in line) for line in roman)
p.write_bytes(header.encode() + b'\\n---\\n' + body)
PY

item.text:
Audited all 105 Roman verse lines in [mai-safire-husain.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/2/workspaces/f7f26f0e70174a188f2153b48e622431/src/data/lyrics/mai-safire-husain.md). Corrected wording and alignment against the Urdu, standardized Roman spelling and izafat, and normalized the Roman title. The Urdu body was preserved.

The intended reading of `میں دور انقلاب لبوں` remains uncertain. The Roman now follows the written Urdu as `Main daur-e-inqilaab laboṅ`, pending editorial confirmation.
